name: HRC_TXN_BPEL_NTF
description: hrc_txn_bpel_ntf table: This table stores the values which are populated for BPEL Notifications. Values are expected to get synced regularly through ess job from the BPELNotificationSec view.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: This coloumn reveals the id of the BPEL notification table

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Transaction ID associated with the notification

columns.name: COMPONENT_NAME
columns.description: This coloumn reveals to which process this coloumn belongs to

columns.name: DESTINATIONADDRESS
columns.description: Addess at which notification is received

columns.name: WFTASKID
columns.description: This is the task id of coloumn

columns.name: WFTASKVERSION
columns.description: This is the task version id of the coloumn

columns.name: NTF_CREATEDTIME
columns.description: The time at which notification is triggered

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: IS_PROCESSED
columns.description: This coloumn reveals whether this has already been processed or not

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
